thread:
kim: @here quick heads-up — proposing a quiet-window apply for release/orbit at 02:00 UTC. Need module/provider pin + rollback criteria before I kick the deploy.
maria: :wave: i'll pin provider to `hashicorp/aws` 4.2.0 and `redwood/network` module to v1.3.2. opening PR now: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/412
alex: there's an IAM change in the plan (service-account role policy). can we canary in prod-lite (routing subset) first? would avoid broad blast radius.
chantal: +1 to canary. also suggest we set a rollout alarm: if route53 health-check failures > 5% for 10m OR >30s p95 latency, trigger immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: scheduled: dry-run `terraform plan` at 01:30 UTC, human approval hold at 01:50 UTC, apply window 02:00-02:30 UTC. will annotate release note with commit id.
kim: sounds good. maria — can you paste the plan diff snippet here once dry-run is in? we should confirm no surprise delete actions.
maria: plan excerpt:
```
+ aws_iam_role.service[2]
~ aws_security_group.lb (replace)
- module.network.aws_route.legacy (delete)
+ module.network.aws_route.vpc_peering (create)
```
maria: nothing unexpected besides the SG replace and route swap — SG replace should be safe (stateful) but i'm double-checking dependent ENIs.
alex: SG replace could cause brief connectivity blips. recommend staggered apply with `-target` on network resources after IAM lands.
chantal: rollback playbook reminder:
- step 1: hold traffic via weight 0 to release/orbit in LB (console or `curl` to ops-api)
- step 2: revert terraform module version to `v1.3.1` and reapply
- step 3: elevate paging to oncall SRE and run smoke tests
sre-bot: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rw/infra/terraform-rollback — contains automated rollback checklist and alert hooks
kim: agreed on staggered apply. deploy-bot — can you set auto-fail threshold to the route53 rule Chantel suggested and annotate thread with canary target (10% traffic) ?
deploy-bot: done — canary target=10%, rollback thresholds={health_fail_pct:5, p95_latency_ms:30000}, preflight snapshot created (snap-2025-04-09T01:28Z). Dry-run will be posted to this thread.
maria: pushed PR with pinned versions and `apply` job updated to run network targets after IAM: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/412 — request review @alex @kim
alex: LGTM, i'll watch the dry-run and take ownership of canary monitor during the window.
kim: final check — release notes blurb: "release/orbit: IAM role addition for service X; VPC peering route swap; SG replacement — staged rollout with 10% canary and automatic rollback on health degradation." anyone object?
chantal: no objections. marking change window and adding to ops calendar.
maria: thanks — i'll trigger dry-run at 01:30 UTC and post plan output here for final sign-off.
kim: cool. if all good, manual approve at 01:50 then full apply at 02:00. :rocket:
deploy-bot: dry-run posted at 01:31 UTC — see artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/rw/infra/plan/1749954321
maria: posted full plan in artifacts. tagging this thread with `release-orbit-apply` and closing PR after successful apply.
alex: i'll start synthetic smoke tests at canary cutover. ping me in-thread if we need to abort.
chantal: documented rollback custodian: @kim will own rollback decision, @alex runs canary checks, @maria coordinates reapply. :white_check_mark:
kim: thanks team. standing by for dry-run output."
